title: Problem 3.7: Least-Squares Fitting
text:

First, we’ll use the numpy.polyfit() method to produce least-squares optimized fits for each of the models given, because our models are already in polynomial form and that method already uses LS2 minimization to produce fitting functions.
We’ll use the leastsquerror() function from the data_fitting.py file (original work copyright 2026) to obtain the cumulative LS2 error. This file is available via public github repo.
We’ll plot the original data against the lines of fit for a visual comparison.
